title: Unit formula for pulled-back generator sections
statement: For schemes X,Y [def-pc-scheme], f:Y→X and an invertible X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module] whose tensor pullback f*L [def-pc-module-pullback] is invertible, let P_W be the explicit pulled-back generator map [lem-sc-etale-generators-pullback-section] between generator torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor]. For every étale W→X, unit g on W and generator s, P_W(g·s)=c_f(η_G(g))·P_W(s), evaluated on W×_X Y. Here η_G and c_f are the abelian étale inverse-image unit [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and its adjoint units comparison. This asserts scalar compatibility of the explicit section map, not existence of an inverse-image sheaf map.

source.place: Lemma 21.6.1, generator torsor construction; pullback/restriction of its trivializations.

proof.text: Use ULift.ext and Subtype.ext, unfold the section construction, and distribute pullback over the composite multiplication-by-g followed by s. Apply the proved upstream pullback_map_smulHom.

The Gm adjunction inverse equation identifies c_f(η_G(g)) with gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf applied to g, namely the units map of the first projection. Move multiplication by this pulled-back function past the three source comparison factors using smulHom_naturality_assoc; the remaining expression is reflexive.

lean.statement: theorem etale_generators_pullback_map_unit_formula {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (L : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} L] [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} ((tensorPullback f).obj L)] : ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : X.gmSheaf.obj.obj (op W)) (s : (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf.obj.obj (op W)), (etaleGeneratorsPullbackSection f L W ((etaleIsoTorsor L).vadd (op W) g s)) = (etaleIsoTorsor ((tensorPullback f).obj L)).vadd (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W)) ((upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf f).hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj W)) (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).unit.app X.gmSheaf).hom.app (op W) g)) (etaleGeneratorsPullbackSection f L W s)
